basic_info.description: Sitting on the border of Pacific Heights and Russian Hill, and just steps to all the restaurants and shops on Polk St, this remodeled two-level top floor townhouse with private roof deck is the perfect blend of design and convenience.  Soaked in natural light and with soaring vaulted ceilings, the open concept living/dining area offers a perfect place for entertaining.  Contiguous to the living area is a beautifully remodeled chef's kitchen with marble countertops, stainless steel appliances and tons of storage.  The home offers 3 bedrooms, one huge bedroom on the main level, and 2 bedrooms on the lower level including a primary suite with a large private bathroom.  A second full bathroom completes the lower level.  One of the many terrific features of the home is the roof deck, offering a private outdoor space just steps from the living room.  In-unit washer and dryer, hardwood floors, fireplace, garage parking and an ideal location are only some of the many features that make this condo so desirable.
